## ✅ METHOD 1: Excel 365 (Built-in – EASIEST)

   ```
3. Select the cell
4. Go to **Data → Data Types → Geography**
5. Click the **insert data icon** next to the cell
6. Choose:
   - Temperature
   - Weather condition
   - Humidity

## ⚠️ First: CNN + Google Sheets
**Direct scraping from CNN will NOT work** in Google Sheets because:

- Google blocks many CNN requests

❌ This will fail:
```excel
=IMPORTXML("https://www.cnn.com/weather","//span")
```

# ✅ METHOD 1: Google Sheets + OPEN-METEO (NO API KEY)
This is the **simplest and best** solution.

### Step 1: Open Google Sheets
Create headers:
```
A1: City
B1: Temperature (°C)
C1: Wind (km/h)
D1: Weather Code
```

---

### Step 2: Apps Script
1. **Extensions → Apps Script**
2. Delete everything
3. Paste this 👇

```javascript
function getWeather() {
  const url = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=43.7&longitude=-79.4&current_weather=true";
  const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url);
  const data = JSON.parse(response.getContentText());

  const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();
  sheet.getRange("B2").setValue(data.current_weather.temperature);
  sheet.getRange("C2").setValue(data.current_weather.windspeed);
  sheet.getRange("D2").setValue(data.current_weather.weathercode);
}
```

4. Save
5. Run **getWeather**
6. Allow permissions

---

### Step 3: Auto Refresh (Optional)
```javascript
function dailyWeatherUpdate() {
  ScriptApp.newTrigger("getWeather")
    .timeBased()
    .everyHours(1)
    .create();
}
```

Run once → updates hourly ⏱️
